title: SchemeTorsorPullbackEquivariantHom
statement: Let $i:Y_0\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $M$ a finite abelian group, $t$ and $t_0$ scheme $M$-torsors over $Y$ and $Y_0$ [lem-galois-etale-torsor-sheaf-torsor]. Suppose $e:P\times_Y Y_0\cong P_0$ lies over $Y_0$ and commutes with every $M$-action map. Set $G=\underline M_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $R$ be an $i^{-1}G$-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], identified with the sheaf torsor of $t_0$ after coefficient transport along the constant-sheaf comparison [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant]. There exists a morphism of sheaves of sets $f:i^{-1}_{\rm set}(t.\mathrm{sheaf})\to R.\mathrm{sheaf}$ satisfying $f(\eta_T(g+\!_v x))=\eta_G(g)+\!_v f(\eta_T(x))$ over $W\times_Y Y_0$, for every $W\in Y_{\acute et}$, $g\in G(W)$ and $x\in t.\mathrm{sheaf}(W)$. No invertibility is asserted.

source.place: Tag 03Q1 (2), (4); Tag 0A5G; Cohomology on Sites Section 03AG

proof.text: The adjunction, Yoneda and representable inverse-image comparison give the canonical sheaf morphism to the base-changed representing scheme. Compose with Yoneda of e and the sheaf isomorphism supplied by hrepr.

On constant coefficient sections, Yoneda evaluation carries the unit to base change; coefficient comparison carries the unit of m to m. The equation is therefore hact after evaluation and coefficient transport.

Coefficient sections locally come from constants by local representability of sheafification. Pull the covering back, restrict the equation by naturality, and use separatedness of R.sheaf to glue the constant-section equations. Only the local-representability clause is needed, not the disputed local-injectivity clause.
